message.content:
Oversized hooded sweatshirt, relaxed boxy cut, mid-thigh length, heather charcoal grey, brushed cotton fleece.  
High-waisted wide-leg yoga pants, tapered at the ankle, full length, deep forest green, technical stretch fabric.  
Minimalist low-top sneakers with white rubber sole and black mesh upper.

This outfit works because the oversized sweatshirt provides warmth against autumn chill without restricting movement for morning poses, while the high waist and wide legs ensure comfort during stretches and holds. The dark forest green hue adds a grounded, natural energy that complements the early morning yoga atmosphere. Together, the soft fleece texture and durable technical fabric balance coziness with the practical needs of an active sports session.
